name: Overseer of the Two Treasuries
body:
Your creator was a politician and administrator, and your memories are filled with the sound of clinking coins.

Prerequisite(s): Shabti.

Benefit(s): You gain a second daily use of your suggestion spell-like ability. You gain a third daily use at 8th level, a fourth at 13th level, and a fifth at 16th level.
